analysis.heat.valueTitle: The heat at this pixel: what every drawn row whose sprite covers it adds, by the sprite's ramp, weight and side - the number the colour scale's saturation point is measured in.
analysis.heat.placeTitle: The rows inside the cell under the pick (two sprite radii across), the unit the heat labels and the comparison with the view use.
analysis.heat.relative: Hotter than {percent}% of the {places} places in view: {median}× the median place, {peak}% of the hottest.
analysis.heat.relativeNegative: More negative than {percent}% of the {places} negative places in view: {median}× the median one, {peak}% of the most negative.
analysis.heat.noPlaces: No other places with heat are in view to compare with.
analysis.heat.orderTitle: Walk the stack by what each row adds, or by time
analysis.heat.jumpTitle: Open the match replay a few seconds before this row, behind whoever it is about
analysis.labels.toggleTitle: Name the hottest places in view with their heat - and, in Difference, the most negative ones too. Chosen again when the camera comes to rest.
analysis.ins.compareGeneric: {ratio}× the rest of the map, after testing {tests} places or groups ({conf}).
analysis.ins.dropped: {n} further findings left out as saying nothing: {list}.
analysis.ins.dropped.exposure: {n} only reflected where everyone spends their time
analysis.ins.dropped.fewEvents: {n} rested on a handful of events
analysis.ins.dropped.spawn: {n} were explained by a spawn nearby
analysis.ins.dropped.trivialKind: {n} were spawns or joins, which happen where the game puts them
analysis.ins.power.kd.what: {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths in this spot about {size} across.
analysis.ins.power.kd.compare: Whoever fights from here wins {hereShare} of their duels, against {mapShare} on the rest of the map: {ratio}× better odds.
analysis.ins.power.kd.why: A power position: holding it wins fights, so players who know the map will go for it.
analysis.ins.power.kd.do: To take it on: deny it early with smoke, suppressing fire or a flank. If it is too strong for the game, open a second angle on it or break its sightline.
analysis.ins.power.safe.what: Only {deaths} deaths in {timeSecs} spent in this area about {size} across.
analysis.ins.power.safe.compare: {hereRate} deaths {per} here against {mapRate} on the rest of the map: {ratio}× safer.
analysis.ins.power.safe.why: Safe ground: a rear area, a covered route or a place out of the sightlines.
analysis.ins.power.safe.do: Use it to move or regroup. If it should be contested, find what keeps the fight out of it.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.what: {share} of all {kind} ({count} of {total}) happened in this area about {size} across.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.compare: Players spent {presShare} of their time here, so about {expected} would be expected if {kind} followed where people are: here there were {ratio}× that.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.why: The place itself makes {kind} happen far beyond its traffic: a sightline, a choke or a kill zone.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.do: Click the heat here to walk through the events and see who caused them from where; look at the cover and the ways in.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.target.compare: Quase ninguém passa tempo aqui ({presShare} de todo o tempo): estes eventos de {kind} caem aqui, enquanto quem os causou está em outro lugar.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.target.why: A target area: an objective, a defended position or ground under fire from somewhere else.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.target.do: Find where they come from: click the heat here and walk through the events and their sources; a volume round the place gives the full statistics.
analysis.ins.zones.cold.what: Only {count} {kind} in this area about {size} across, although players spent {presShare} of their time here.
analysis.ins.zones.cold.compare: About {expected} would be expected for that time: {ratio}× fewer.
analysis.ins.zones.cold.why: People pass or wait here but {kind} rarely happen: a quiet route or a place outside the fight.
analysis.ins.zones.cold.do: If the place is meant to be fought over, it is not drawing the fight; see why players pass through without engaging.
analysis.ins.cover.open.what: Out in the open, players die {ratio}× as often per minute as among dense level geometry.
analysis.ins.cover.open.compare: {deathsOpen} deaths in {presenceOpen} in the most open third of the ground, against {deathsDense} in {presenceDense} in the densest third.
analysis.ins.cover.open.why: Cover works on this level: open crossings are where fights are lost.
analysis.ins.cover.open.do: Cross open ground fast, together or under smoke. If open crossings decide too many fights, add cover along them.
analysis.ins.cover.dense.what: Among dense level geometry, players die {ratio}× as often per minute as in the open.
analysis.ins.cover.dense.compare: {deathsDense} deaths in {presenceDense} in the densest third of the ground, against {deathsOpen} in {presenceOpen} in the most open third.
analysis.ins.cover.dense.why: Close quarters are the danger here: fights inside and around buildings are short and lethal.
analysis.ins.cover.dense.do: Clear rooms as a team and pre-aim corners; avoid entering buildings alone.
analysis.ins.cover.slow.what: Standing still or moving slowly, players die {ratio}× as often per minute as when moving fast.
analysis.ins.cover.slow.compare: {deathsSlow} deaths in {presenceSlow} below {slowBelow} units/s, against {deathsFast} in {presenceFast} above {fastAbove} units/s.
analysis.ins.cover.slow.why: Holding still gets people killed: a static target is easy to find and to hit.
analysis.ins.cover.slow.do: Keep moving between positions; hold only where the position covers you.
analysis.ins.cover.fast.what: Moving fast, players die {ratio}× as often per minute as when moving slowly.
analysis.ins.cover.fast.compare: {deathsFast} deaths in {presenceFast} above {fastAbove} units/s, against {deathsSlow} in {presenceSlow} below {slowBelow} units/s.
analysis.ins.cover.fast.why: Running into fights loses them: whoever waits sees the runner first.
analysis.ins.cover.fast.do: Slow down before contact; let the enemy come to a held position.
analysis.ins.spawn.trap.what: {earlyPct} of the {spawns} spawns of {team} here die within {earlySecs}.
analysis.ins.spawn.trap.compare: {ratio}× the early deaths at {team}'s other spawns; the first contact comes after {contactSecs} (median).
analysis.ins.spawn.trap.why: A spawn trap: the enemy can reach or see this spawn too easily, and the players spawning there lose before they can act.
analysis.ins.spawn.trap.do: Move the spawn, shield it or block the lines into it. As a player, avoid spawning here while it is watched.
analysis.ins.spawn.strong.what: Players of {team} spawning here make {ratio}× the kills of {team}'s other spawns in their first {earlySecs}.
analysis.ins.spawn.strong.compare: Over {spawns} spawns; the first contact comes after {contactSecs} (median).
analysis.ins.spawn.strong.why: A strong spawn: it puts players straight into winning fights.
analysis.ins.spawn.strong.do: As {team}, spawn here when it is free. If it is unfair, push it back or open it to the other side.
analysis.ins.spawn.safe.what: Only {earlyPct} of the {spawns} spawns of {team} here die within {earlySecs}.
analysis.ins.spawn.safe.compare: {ratio}× fewer early deaths than at {team}'s other spawns.
analysis.ins.spawn.safe.why: A safe spawn: players get time to get ready and move out.
analysis.ins.spawn.safe.do: A good place to come back in when the front is close elsewhere.
analysis.ins.classPlace.strong.what: {class} get {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths in this area about {size} across.
analysis.ins.classPlace.strong.compare: {ratio}× their kill-to-death odds elsewhere on the map.
analysis.ins.classPlace.strong.why: This ground suits {class}: its terrain and ranges play to their strengths.
analysis.ins.classPlace.strong.do: Bring {class} here, or counter them with what beats them on this ground; balance: check their tools on this terrain.
analysis.ins.classPlace.weak.what: {class} get only {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths in this area about {size} across.
analysis.ins.classPlace.weak.compare: {ratio}× worse kill-to-death odds than they have elsewhere.
analysis.ins.classPlace.weak.why: This ground is bad for {class}: they are out of their element here.
analysis.ins.classPlace.weak.do: Keep {class} out of here, or escort them through; balance: this place may need something that helps them.
analysis.ins.classPlace.actorStrong.what: {actor} get {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths in this area about {size} across.
analysis.ins.classPlace.actorStrong.comp: {ratio}× their kill-to-death odds elsewhere on the map.
analysis.ins.classPlace.actorWeak.what: {actor} get only {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths in this area about {size} across.
analysis.ins.classPlace.actorWeak.compar: {ratio}× worse kill-to-death odds than they have elsewhere.
analysis.ins.players.over.compare: {ratio}× the kill rate of comparable players over the same time.
analysis.ins.players.under.compare: {ratio}× fewer kills per minute than comparable players.
analysis.ins.players.fragile.compare: {ratio}× as often per minute as comparable players.
analysis.ins.players.durable.compare: {ratio}× less often per minute than comparable players.
analysis.ins.flow.choke.what: {crossings} crossings went through this spot about {size} across, and {deaths} players died here.
analysis.ins.flow.choke.compare: {around}× the traffic of the ground around it; {herePer} of the crossings here end in a death, against {mapPer} on the map.
analysis.ins.flow.choke.why: A choke point: movement funnels through here, so whoever controls it decides who gets where.
analysis.ins.flow.choke.do: Hold it with crossfire, or go round it. If it decides too much, a second way past eases it.
analysis.ins.flow.flank.what: Crossing here leads to {kills} kills within {approachSecs}, though only {sharePct} of all crossings use this way.
analysis.ins.flow.flank.compare: {ratio}× the kills per crossing of the other ways.
analysis.ins.flow.flank.why: An underused flank: the few who take it win fights, because nobody watches it.
analysis.ins.flow.flank.do: Attackers: use it more, but not every round. Defenders: put a watch on it.
analysis.ins.value.lost.what: {value} {unit} were lost in this area about {size} across, {share}% of all that was lost.
analysis.ins.value.lost.compare: {ratio}× the rate of losing elsewhere for the time spent here.
analysis.ins.value.lost.why: Costly ground: what is lost here is lost faster than anywhere else.
analysis.ins.value.lost.do: Avoid sending expensive units through here, or bring what protects them.
analysis.ins.value.earned.what: {value} {unit} were earned in this area about {size} across, {share}% of all that was earned.
analysis.ins.value.earned.compare: {ratio}× the rate of earning elsewhere for the time spent here.
analysis.ins.value.earned.why: Earning ground: time spent here pays.
analysis.ins.value.earned.do: Spend more time here, and deny it to the other side.
analysis.ins.det.players.why: A player's own result against comparable players over the same time, not against the whole server: the gap is their play, not their role.
analysis.ins.det.players.do: Watch this player's replay: what they do differently is the lesson, for them or for the rest.
analysis.ins.det.outcome.why: Rounds are what win the match: a factor that moves the round win rate is worth more than any single fight.
analysis.ins.det.outcome.do: Train what goes with winning rounds; in a review, look at the rounds without it.
analysis.ins.det.classPlace.why: Where a kind of vehicle or class wins and loses tells how the map plays for it.
analysis.ins.det.classPlace.do: Pick the ground that suits what you bring; balance: check the class on this terrain.
analysis.ins.det.zones.why: Events cluster here beyond what the time spent explains.
analysis.ins.det.zones.do: Click the heat here to walk through the events.
analysis.ins.det.value.why: Where value is won or lost is where the economy of the match is decided.
analysis.ins.det.value.do: Bring expensive units where they earn, not where they are lost.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.passing.compare: Players spent only {presShare} of their time here: they stop here to fire and move on, {ratio}× what that time would predict.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.passing.why: A firing spot used in passing: a good angle that is safe only for a moment.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.passing.do: Use it to shoot and move. To deny it, pre-aim it or cover it from a second angle.
analysis.engage.hint: A line joins two opponents while they fight: solid from the first shot, hit or kill between them to the last, dashed for the seconds before and after. It never outlives either life and ends when one side breaks off.
analysis.contours.title: Draw a line in each volume's colour where it cuts the ground, the walls and every other surface of the level
analysis.cinema.onTitle: The caster moves the camera to each moment itself, without cuts, and circles the fight while it plays
analysis.cinema.subtitlesTitle: Each moment's line and its numbers over the view, the player and the other party ringed
analysis.cinema.resumeTitle: You moved the camera, so the caster let go: give it back
analysis.cinema.closeTitle: Stop the caster's camera and subtitles
analysis.path.keyTimeTitle: When this key is reached, seconds into the video
analysis.path.easeTitle: How the move to the next key starts and ends
analysis.path.timingKeysTitle: Each key is reached at its own time; set the times in the list
analysis.path.timingConstantTitle: The camera moves at one speed along the whole path; the keys set its shape, the duration its pace
analysis.path.evenTitle: Give each move between keys the same share of the video
analysis.path.loadTitle: Load this path: its keys, timing, duration and frame rate
analysis.path.importFailed: That file holds no camera paths.
analysis.video.mkvTitle: Matroska with H.264 (VP9 where H.264 is not available)
analysis.video.webmTitle: WebM with VP9 (VP8 where VP9 is not available)
analysis.video.noAvcConfig: The H.264 encoder gave no decoder setup, so no MP4 can be written; try MKV or WebM.
analysis.views.title: Saved views
analysis.views.hint: Keep the analysis as it stands - camera, mode, filters, layers, selection and time - with a note, and come back to it with a click.
analysis.views.name: Name
analysis.views.openTitle: Put this view back: camera, mode, filters, layers, selection and time
analysis.views.updateTitle: Replace this view with what is on screen now (the name and note stay)
analysis.views.importFailed: That file holds no saved views.
analysis.views.missing: Restored, except what this data does not have: {list}.
analysis.ins.spread: Visto em {holding} de {matches} {unit, select, round {rodadas} other {partidas}}; {unit, select, round {a maior rodada sozinha responde por} other {a maior partida sozinha responde por}} {top}.
analysis.ins.side.deaths: {share} de quem morre aqui é de {team}.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.crossing.compare: Os jogadores passam aqui apenas {presShare} do seu tempo, mas {count} morreram aqui, {ratio}× o que esse tempo faria prever: morre-se ao atravessá-lo.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.crossing.why: Uma travessia mortal: alguém a vigia, e ninguém fica tempo suficiente para reagir.
analysis.ins.zones.hot.crossing.do: Atravesse rápido, sob fumaça ou coberto por um colega; encontre a posição que a vigia e negue-a.
analysis.ins.zones.cold.none.what: Nenhum {kind} nesta área de cerca de {size} de largura, embora os jogadores tenham passado {presShare} do seu tempo aqui.
analysis.ins.power.safe.none.what: Nenhuma morte em {timeSecs} passados nesta área de cerca de {size} de largura.
analysis.ins.power.safe.none.compare: O resto do mapa registra {mapRate} mortes {per}.
analysis.ins.flow.choke.none.what: {crossings} travessias passaram por este ponto de cerca de {size} de largura, e ninguém morreu aqui.
analysis.ins.flow.choke.none.compare: {around}× o tráfego do terreno ao redor; ninguém morreu aqui até agora.
analysis.ins.cover.slow.speed.compare: {deathsSlow} mortes em {presenceSlow} abaixo de {slowBelow}, contra {deathsFast} em {presenceFast} acima de {fastAbove}.
analysis.ins.cover.fast.speed.compare: {deathsFast} mortes em {presenceFast} acima de {fastAbove}, contra {deathsSlow} em {presenceSlow} abaixo de {slowBelow}.
analysis.ins.dropped.covered: {n} eram eliminações por local, que as posições de poder já mostram
analysis.ins.dropped.oneMatch: {n} vinham sobretudo de {unit, select, round {uma única rodada} other {uma única partida}}
analysis.ins.dropped.fewMatches: {n} se sustentavam em muito poucas {unit, select, round {rodadas} other {partidas}}
analysis.ins.dropped.samePlace: {n} repetiam um local já listado para outro tipo de evento
analysis.ins.dropped.similar: {n} eram mais do mesmo tipo que a lista já tem
analysis.ins.dropped.consequence: {n} decorriam de vencer a rodada em vez de levar a isso (plantar a bomba, manter um local)
analysis.ins.det.outcome.compare: As rodadas do mesmo lado com isso contra as sem isso. Isso mostra o que acompanha a vitória, não o que a causa: um lado que está na frente faz mais de tudo.
analysis.ins.dropped.confounded: {n} misturavam causa e efeito (as pessoas desaceleram, ou correm, para lutar)
analysis.ins.dropped.mostOfIt: {n} reuniam a maior parte desses eventos: a luta inteira, não um lugar dentro dela
